A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XXIV · the armadillo family

Armoured

The armadillo girls: banded armour on their backs, and when they are scared they roll up into a ball.

Favourite food: Insects and spider eyes; she likes beetroot

I · HarpiesII · Bullywugs & Mucus ToadsIII · NekomataIV · KitsuneV · LamiaVI · ArachneVII · CentaursVIII · MerfolkIX · SlimesX · JackalopesXI · MinotaursXII · MollusksXIII · ElvesXIV · UndeadXV · LizardfolkXVI · DragonsXVII · DevilsXVIII · BugsXIX · FloraXX · CanidsXXI · RodentsXXII · CrustaceansXXIII · MarsupialsXXIV · ArmouredXXV · ConstructsXXVI · BatsXXVII · Theropods
The central similarity

Roll up.

Frightened, she rolls up into a ball, and nothing gets through. Befriended, she rolls into whatever goes for you.

  • BallNo damage while rolled up.
  • Rolling chargeBefriended, she rolls into monsters.
  • ScutesShe sheds armadillo scutes as presents.
  • KinVanilla armadillos.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a armoured builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Spider eyes (+2), beetroot and sweet berries (+1)
  • Petting

What costs trust

  • Hitting her

Devoted (60+)

She rolls into anything that hurts you.

Mating & young

FormLive young. YoungPups, grown in 5 days. WhereBeside her. Young use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed.
2. YoungA day later she bears young.
3. GrowingHer young stay by their mother.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

Rolling upA hit or a sprinting stranger rolls her up for a few seconds: she takes no damage.
Rolling chargeBefriended, she curls up and rolls into a monster near her friend, knocking it back.

Species profiles

Savanna & badlandsTimid · tough

Armadillo (about 1.45 blocks)

TemperamentTimid, then very tough

Ecology & behaviourArmadillos (Cingulata: Dasypodidae): banded armour of bony scutes. The three-banded one rolls into a perfect ball.

Signature: Roll upA hit or a sprinting stranger rolls her into a ball: she takes no damage. Befriended, she rolls into monsters near her friend. The ranger variant wears a cowboy hat and scarf, a rolling frontier guard.

Player interactionSpider eyes, beetroot and berries.

Colour variants

Nine-banded (default) · Grey-brownThree-banded · TanPink fairy · Pink and whiteGiant · DarkRanger · Rust-orange, cowboy hat and scarf

Spawns insavanna, badlands, wooded_badlands

DangerNone.

ForestsStalwart · stubborn

Aegis Boar (about 1.9 blocks)

TemperamentStalwart

Ecology & behaviourA Harmontide boar in plate armour, tusked and broad, who stands in front of whoever she guards.

Signature: ShieldBefriended, she takes a third of every hit meant for her friend within 8 blocks, and charges what struck them.

Player interactionCarrots, potatoes and beetroot.

Colour variants

Spawns inforest, dark_forest, old_growth_spruce_taiga

JunglesSlow · mossy

Slothren (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentSlow, serene

Ecology & behaviourA Harmontide sloth, a cousin of the armadillos, so slow that moss and flowers grow in her fur.

Signature: MossyShe hangs from branches by day and barely moves. Moss and flowers spread around where she rests; befriended, crops and saplings near her grow as if bone-mealed.

Player interactionLeaves and glow berries. Do not hurry her.

Colour variants

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Daeodon: befriended, she roots up a potato, carrot or beetroot at her friend's feet. Anteater: befriended, she licks up the loose items near her friend and brings them to their feet
  • Armadillo: a hit or a sprinting stranger rolls her up (no damage gets through)
  • Befriended, she rolls into monsters near her friend
  • Sheds armadillo scutes as presents; kin of vanilla armadillos
  • Sometimes identical quadruplets
  • The ranger variant: a cowboy hat and scarf
  • Riverdillo: in the water near her friend she catches fish and brings them
  • Gribboar: every half minute she roots in the earth under her and digs up mushrooms, potatoes, carrots, now and then a gold nugget
  • Slothren: by day she hangs from the nearest branch above her; she spreads moss and flowers where she rests, and befriended she grows the crops and saplings under her
  • Aegis boar: never rolls up; takes a third of every blow meant for her friend within 8 blocks and turns on the attacker; hoglins are her kin

Not yet

  • A pangolin

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • One species for now (2026-10-25), with a ranger variant (a cowboy hat and scarf).
